Comment-state records describe limited failure localization, while display requirements distinguish real zero activity from failed processing. Together they motivate preserving processing state separately from business values.

results.title: Implement granular comments download status enum for Reddit
results.summary:
Introduce / Reuse status enum Use the existing generic process/download status enum pattern (as in Weibo's ProcessStatus or DownloadStatus): NOT_STARTED PENDING / IN_PROGRESS (choose one naming convention and use consistently) COMPLETED / DONE FAILED
It is hard to query for stuck/errored comment collections per post Operational monitoring and debugging are harder (no way to see where comment pipelines are failing or stuck)
Today, comment download completion is tracked only as a boolean flag at the post level (comments_downloaded: bool) in both: CommonPostMetadata (ElasticSearch) RedditPostMetadata (Mongo)
